Welcome to a practical guide to AI-first workflows for clinical study reports.

This book explores how organizations can move from isolated AI adoption toward
an AI-native way of working by building **AI-first workflows** across clinical
study reports. In these workflows, an AI agent performs a bounded, repeatable
first pass; people define and monitor the process, review the evidence, and
remain responsible for decisions.

The focus is not a particular model or software stack. Instead, it is on
durable principles that teams can adapt to their own technology, governance,
and operating environment.

The [Preface](01-preface.qmd) states who the book is written for, what you will
be able to do after reading it, and how the material is organized.
